title: Type B helical video recorders
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard applies to magnetic video recording and/or reproduction using 25*4 mm tape on Type B helical-scan recorders suitable for broadcast applications.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Spools for 25.4 mm Video Magnetic Tape

dimensional_tolerances: tolerance on the indicated frequencies shall be ± 0'05 M
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
